en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a long, low wooden building with many windows, likely a spa or resort pavilion, set behind a landscaped garden with flowerbeds, lawns, and benches. There are a few people near the building. The style suggests an early‑20th‑century European spa town. The bottom border contains handwritten-style captions with the words "Kemeri" on the left and "Kurmaja" on the right.
